task: Extend Confluence loader retry to cover transient ConnectionError/RemoteDisconnected (including get_all_restrictions_for_content) alongside 502/503/504, with actionable exhaustion errors and tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the tenacity @retry on ConfluenceDatasourceLoader._search_content_by_cql, but it does not cover the failing call get_all_restrictions_for_content, which runs inside upstream langchain_community ConfluenceLoader.process_pages. The fix needs a wrap or override of upstream behaviour. The predicate must retry ConnectionError but never auth/authz errors. AC enumerates edge and error cases (502/503/504, RemoteDisconnected, exhaustion) with no existing parameterized test template, so Technical Risk is bumped from M to L.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: enumerated edge/error AC cases with no existing test template, and the retry must exclude auth/authz errors
